title: 💎 PRO, Secret Offer & Endless Run Results (v1.1.0)
message: This update brings Local Train India PRO, a secret scratch card offer, a proper ending for endless runs and many small improvements.
points: 💎 NEW: Local Train India PRO. Pay once and keep it forever. No ads, and every rake, line and journey option is open.
🎟️ NEW: Secret scratch card. Open the PRO page and scratch the card to reveal a special price. It lasts only 1 hour, so do not miss it!
🏁 NEW: End your endless run anytime. Tap PAUSE, then END RUN to see your total runs, score and distance.
🔔 NEW: Update notices. The game now tells you when a new version is ready and shows what is new.
⭐ Rate the game without leaving it. After a good trip you can give stars right inside the game.
🎉 New sounds and confetti when you unlock the offer or become a PRO member.

title: 🚆 Welcome to Local Train India (v1.0.0)
message: Drive suburban locals across Mumbai, Chennai, Kolkata, Delhi and more.
points: 🚉 Real suburban lines with stations, signals and level crossings
🛠️ Line Studio: build and share your own lines
🌦️ Day, night, monsoon and winter haze driving
